text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's another day of training with Admire Vega.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her movements are shockingly sluggish. Feeling a little worried, I call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Leave me alone. I can't stop now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have to train harder and increase my speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Admire Vega speaks with a firm, determined tone, it seems exhaustion is catching up with her. I should consider reevaluating her race schedule.
